name: acc_cp2_priority_preempt
description: Acceptance fixture (hash-frozen, NOT included in CP-1 totals): priority pre-emption under CP-2. A low-priority long-running job is running when a high-priority short job arrives. The CP-2 controller releases the low-priority job's parent PG and admits the high-priority job, then re-admits the low-priority job. Demonstrates that CP-2 can coordinate resource handoff. Under FIFO/greedy this coordination does not happen.
